import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
mpl.rcParams.update({ "text.usetex": False, "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 11, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": "#263238", "svg.fonttype": "none", })
# Exact input data; use the unnormalized, negative-exponent forward DFT. N = 4 x = np.array([1, 2, 0, 1], dtype=float) h = np.array([2, 1, 0, 0], dtype=float) j, k = np.meshgrid(np.arange(N), np.arange(N)) F = np.exp(-2j * np.pi * j * k / N) X = F @ x H = F @ h Y = X * H C_h = np.array([[h[(r - c) % N] for c in range(N)] for r in range(N)]) y = C_h @ x
if not ( np.allclose(X, [4, 1-1j, -2, 1+1j]) and np.allclose(H, [3, 2-1j, 1, 2+1j]) and np.allclose(Y, [12, 1-3j, -2, 1+3j]) and np.allclose(y, [3, 5, 2, 2]) and np.allclose(C_h, F.conj().T @ np.diag(H) @ F / N) ): raise ValueError("The convolution and DFT data are inconsistent.")
blue = "#33658A" teal = "#2A9D8F" ink = "#263238" muted = "#657786"
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.6, 3.9), dpi=100) ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1]) ax.set_xlim(0, 1) ax.set_ylim(0, 1) ax.axis("off")
def label(xpos, ypos, text, size=11, color=ink, **kwargs): return ax.text( xpos, ypos, text, fontsize=size, color=color, ha=kwargs.pop("ha", "center"), va=kwargs.pop("va", "center"), **kwargs )
def arrow(start, end, color): ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( start, end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=13, linewidth=1.7, color=color, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, ))
label(0.5, 0.935, "Discrete convolution theorem", size=18, weight="semibold") label( 0.5, 0.85, r"$N=4$ • $h=[2,\ 1,\ 0,\ 0]^{T}$ • Circular convolution", size=11, color=muted )
# Time-domain route. label(0.16, 0.735, r"$x$", size=17, color=blue) label(0.16, 0.67, r"$[1,\ 2,\ 0,\ 1]^{T}$", size=12) label(0.84, 0.735, r"$y=x\circledast h$", size=16, color=blue) label(0.84, 0.67, r"$[3,\ 5,\ 2,\ 2]^{T}$", size=12)
arrow((0.315, 0.715), (0.685, 0.715), blue) label(0.5, 0.77, "Convolution with h", size=11, color=blue) label(0.5, 0.66, r"$O(N^{2})$", size=11, color=muted)
# The vertical maps make the two routes commute. arrow((0.16, 0.61), (0.16, 0.405), teal) label(0.185, 0.52, r"DFT $F_4$", size=11, color=teal, ha="left")
arrow((0.84, 0.405), (0.84, 0.61), teal) label(0.815, 0.53, r"IDFT $\frac{1}{4}F_4^{H}$", size=11, color=teal, ha="right")
# Frequency-domain route. In particular, X_2 = -2, not 0. label(0.16, 0.35, r"$X=F_4x$", size=15, color=teal) label(0.16, 0.285, r"$[4,\ 1-i,\ -2,\ 1+i]^{T}$", size=11.5) label(0.84, 0.35, r"$Y=X\odot H$", size=15, color=teal) label(0.84, 0.285, r"$[12,\ 1-3i,\ -2,\ 1+3i]^{T}$", size=11.5)
arrow((0.315, 0.34), (0.685, 0.34), teal) label(0.5, 0.405, r"Pointwise product $Y_k=X_kH_k$", size=11, color=teal) label(0.5, 0.285, r"$O(N)$", size=11, color=muted) label(0.5, 0.215, r"$H=F_4h=[3,\ 2-i,\ 1,\ 2+i]^{T}$", size=11)
# Diagonalization and normalization convention. label( 0.5, 0.115, r"Circulant diagonalization: $C_h=\frac{1}{4}F_4^{H}\,\mathrm{diag}(H)\,F_4$", size=12, color=blue ) label( 0.5, 0.045, r"DFT convention: $(F_4)_{kn}=e^{-2\pi i kn/4}$" " • Dimensionless data; costs refer to the two product steps", size=9, color=muted )
